incomeTax.note: Flat rate reduced from 5.19% to 4.99% for tax year 2026 under HB 463. Scheduled contingent reductions of 0.125 percentage points until reaching 3.99%.

valueCap.label: Homestead exemption (local option, no statewide annual cap)

statewideExemptions.label: Regular school homestead exemption
statewideExemptions.note: Amount varies by county; $10,000 is typical (DeKalb, Gwinnett).

propertyFramework.note: TODO: UNVERIFIED. Georgia does not have a statewide appraisal cap like Texas. Homestead exemptions are county- and city-specific. Assessment ratio is 40% of fair market value. No fixed statewide revaluation schedule.

stateSalesTax.note: Groceries are exempt from the 4% state tax but remain subject to local sales taxes. Local add-ons can push combined rates to 8%–9%.

vehicle.note: TODO: UNVERIFIED. Title Ad Valorem Tax (TAVT) is a one-time 7% tax on fair market value, replacing both sales tax and annual ad valorem tax. New residents pay 3%. Fee amounts unverified.
